record.title: Observe complete acquired catalog under derived capability
record.intent: Test interaction of the complete acquired ordinary catalog with explicit capability selection.
requirements: Only after accepted stock control, run the separately frozen derived native copy through initial reload, fresh-process reload and actual guest reboot.

Require public MHO984, selected MHO984D row and bandwidth18/18 before/after stock option policy; require exact stock-control catalog and canonical files, all original consumers, zero installer/producer calls, precise native transformation, complete journals and stable guest health.
Preserve any failure without changing its experiment. Seal and commit/push conclusion. No physical contact and no analog performance or ordinary1GHz entitlement claim.
acceptance: The bounded transition and evidence limits are recorded.

review.rationale: Open contract review only: the failed recorder run cannot open the derived gate. New stock-retry prerequisite retains unchanged fixtures and demands independent acceptance after the bounded controller repair. No execution success is asserted by this review.

evidence.consumer: Reviewed controller-repair plan and acquired-combined-capability report. Derived execution still requires an accepted fresh stock control; decision must reconcile both arms and failed first run.
